QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] A Common Foe?
QuestInfo.0: It appears that #p2152004# is hiding her identity from the Black Wings. Meet her at #m310000000# Park 3.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2152004# introduced herself as a member of the Resistance, an organization formed to fight the Black Wings. Being on the same side, you suggested a team-up, but #p2152004# doesn't trust you yet.

She's asked you to enter #bGelimer's Laboratory using the entrance Behind the Mine#k. Bring back 30 Black Wing Emblems, and she'll accept your offer.
QuestInfo.2: The enemy of my enemy is my friend, or at least my enemy's problem...

1.0: You could have gotten these from your commanders, but I feel like I can trust you regardless. The Resistance is on your side -- unless you ever cross us.
1.1: Lucky for you, we've liberated some intelligence from the Black Wings that mentioned your Onyx Dragon. I would have put you down the moment you came snooping around if it hadn't been for that.
1.2: But I can't turn down aid against the Black Wings, and you've proven you're tough enough to take them on. I apologize if I seem mistrusting, but it's the nature of our movement. Unfortunately, we don't quite have the resources to approach things any other way.
1.3: In the past, five heroes joined forces to stand against the fallen Transcendent, the Black Mage. However, their power alone wasn't enough to stop the Black Mage. That is why the hero Freud used a tool called the Seal Stone to seal the Black Mage.
1.4: Times have change, though. People all over the continent are looking for a chance to rise up and fight the Black Mage. A change is sweeping across the land, and it's all coming together in that Continental Conference. I know we don't know one another very well, but would you consider joining me on my trip there?

item.0: You're back and you don't have any of those Black Wing emblems? What are you trying to pull?
